title: P3.7-M worth of illegal cigarettes seized in Camarines Sur
summary: Police arrested three suspects and seized P3.719 million worth of smuggled cigarettes during a buy-bust operation in Barangay Godofredo Reyes Sr. (GRS) on Tuesday afternoon, November 17.
